actionResult.summary: Review 098 Explore：archive→checkpoint EOF hygiene 的 authority placement正确，098没有把 normalization迁入 archive；existing F1 contract/service仍要求 archive completed后进入 authorize-checkpoint，exact Owner checkpoint authorization存在后才允许 Executor做严格 EOF-only mechanics。唯一 blocker在 public checkpoint handoff proof depth：098把‘消除聊天依赖、让 stable runner给出 deterministic checkpoint mechanics’作为H1 self-hosting acceptance gap，但现有 prepareCheckpointBoundaryHandoff()只返回通用 subject/trailers/normalization scope/preflight，不识别具体 candidate/archive-touched paths或具体 EOF operations，因此简单暴露 public CLI并不能证明其声称的 acceptance；同时 Open Decision仍允许该 public surface直接执行 EOF mutation，H1 formal scope又没有证明需要新增 write-side checkpoint command。应在 revise-explore中收紧为真正最小 closure：要么证明并冻结 read-only public handoff/preflight projection，能从正式 repository/Git facts确定 exact bounded normalization plan且不写工作树；实际 EOF normalization继续属于 authorize-checkpoint后的 Executor mechanics；要么删除 public surface作为H1 requirement并证明现有 Executor contract已足以self-host。不得把archive或stable runner扩成Checkpoint Adapter/Git automation。其他 prerequisite、temporal Actual delay、future-shaped E2E、Verification physical closure与performance observation扫描未发现第二个 blocker。

reviewFindings.title: public checkpoint handoff 的 necessity/authority proof 未覆盖 exact normalization plan，且 Open Decision 仍允许扩大为 write-side checkpoint mechanics
reviewFindings.problem: 098 Proof D 已正确证明 EOF-only normalization authority属于 archive completed 之后的 exact authorize-checkpoint Owner boundary，并由 Executor mechanics执行；但 Proof E 进一步把‘stable runner缺少 public checkpoint handoff surface’定义为 H1 acceptance gap，声称公开现有 prepareCheckpointBoundaryHandoff()即可消除当前 canonical dogfood依赖聊天知道哪几个 EOF 文件。实际 production service只返回 changeId、Owner ref、canonical subject/trailers、通用 normalization scope/allowed/forbidden 与 Git preflight，不读取 Git working tree、candidate/archive-touched path set，也不返回具体需要 normalization 的文件/operation。因此 Evidence Boundary只证明‘已有 generic handoff contract可读’，没有证明‘public stable-runner surface可以从 repository facts确定 exact checkpoint hygiene plan并消除聊天依赖’。同时 §8 Open Decision 仍允许 public surface直接执行 EOF-only mutation；这不是 H1 formal required outcome已经证明必需的能力，并可能把 stable runner扩大为新的 write-side checkpoint executor/adapter surface。
reviewFindings.contractRef: Flowkit Explore Skill v2 §4.1 Scope/Prerequisite Proof、§4.3 Activation/Self-hosting、§5 Proof Acceptance Depth；flowkit-archive-and-checkpoint-boundary canonical spec ‘Checkpoint handoff必须绑定 exact Owner authorization且不执行 Git mutation’；03 Planned Changes v6 H1 stable runner/self-hosting acceptance；Operating Model v8 Executor/Git authority boundary
reviewFindings.invariant: Archive action不得获得 EOF normalization authority；EOF-only normalization只能在 exact authorize-checkpoint Owner fact存在后作为 Executor mechanics发生。H1如果新增 public checkpoint surface，必须是证明 self-hosting所必需的最小 closure，不能成为第二个 Checkpoint Adapter/Git automation，也不能把‘generic规则可读’误写成‘exact normalization plan可由 stable runner确定’。
reviewFindings.requiredOutcome: Revise Explore 收紧 Proof E/Feasible Proposal Boundary/Open Decisions。Reviewer不限定唯一实现：可以保留一个最薄 public surface，但必须用 disposable proof证明它从正式 repository/Git facts + exact Owner checkpoint authorization得到足够 deterministic 的 read-only checkpoint handoff/preflight（包括如果 acceptance声称消除聊天选文件，则必须证明 exact bounded path/operation plan如何确定）；实际 EOF bytes mutation仍留给授权后的 Executor mechanics。或者，如果无法证明 public surface是H1必需的，就从H1 required closure中删除它，E2E继续消费既有 F1 handoff contract + Executor mechanics。两种路径都不得让 archive执行 normalization，也不得自动 stage/commit/push/PR/merge。
acceptance: 明确确认 archive success只关闭 Change；EOF normalization时机仍是 completed → authorize-checkpoint Owner fact → Executor mechanics，archive Run/CLI不得执行 formatter或EOF mutation。

如果保留 public checkpoint surface：证明它是 H1 stable-runner/self-hosting所需的最小 operator/read projection，而不是新 lifecycle Action/Run/Agent Adapter；至少输出 exact Delivery/Change/Owner binding、subject/trailers、bounded normalization authority与preflight。

如果声称 public surface消除‘聊天知道哪几个 EOF 文件’依赖，则用 disposable canonical-like workspace实际证明 exact candidate/archive-touched path set与EOF-only operations可由 repository/Git facts确定；unrelated dirty、semantic/internal whitespace、trailing-space或broad-formatting case必须 fail closed。
public surface本身保持 read-only；不得自动修改 EOF bytes、stage、commit、push、merge/rebase。实际 EOF-only mutation仍由 exact authorize-checkpoint后的 Executor mechanics执行。
若 Author选择不新增 public surface，则证明 existing F1 handoff contract + Executor mechanics已足以让 H1 future-Delivery-shaped E2E在无聊天隐藏状态下完成 checkpoint，并删除Proof E中‘current stable runner acceptance FAIL’的过度结论。
不扩展 H1到 Checkpoint Adapter、Git automation、new checkpoint state、Registry或04 Engineering Health。
evidence: 098 explore.md Proof D correctly states archive success -> Owner authorize-checkpoint -> EOF-only Executor mechanics; Feasible Proposal Boundary #3 repeats that archive/checkpoint authority separation MUST remain.

Canonical openspec/specs/flowkit-archive-and-checkpoint-boundary/spec.md requires checkpoint handoff to bind exact Owner authorization, allows EOF-only normalization only as Executor mechanics, and requires Flowkit handoff itself not to perform Git mutation/commit/push or create a Run.

Base src/services/f1-checkpoint-boundary-service.ts prepareCheckpointBoundaryHandoff() is read-only and returns only deliveryId/changeId/owner ref, subject/trailers, generic normalization authority/scope/allowed/forbidden, and preflight commands; it does not inspect Git dirty paths or enumerate candidate/archive-touched files/EOF operations.

098 Proof E claims the current stable runner acceptance fails because canonical dogfood needed external handoff to know four EOF candidate files, but its evidence only proves an internal generic handoff service lacks a public CLI consumer; that does not prove a public wrapper can identify those exact files from formal/repository facts.

098 Open Decisions #1 explicitly leaves open whether the new public surface only outputs a plan or directly executes EOF-only mutation, even though H1 formal outputs are stable runner/full fixture/self-hosting acceptance/post-03 SystemArchitectureRef and do not independently require a new write-side checkpoint command.
reviewFindings.impact: If Proposal treats Proof E as already sufficient, H1 can either add a public command that still leaves exact EOF-file discovery to chat/manual knowledge (failing its stated self-hosting closure), or expand the stable runner into a write-side checkpoint-normalization command without evidence that this is necessary. Either path weakens the archive/checkpoint authority boundary and risks turning H1 into a Checkpoint Adapter/Git automation change instead of final self-hosting acceptance.
